subject: English
passage: In 1962, botanist Dr. Dorothy Somerby established the Desert Plant Conservancy, an environmental ______ that is the longest-running organization for desert ecosystem protection in the Southwest and that has helped hundreds of researchers study endangered cacti species.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. "That is…Southwest" is an essential supplement, so we should not use punctuation to separate it from "environmental organization."

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. This choice creates a punctuation error. "That is…Southwest" is an essential supplement, so we should not use a comma (or any kind of punctuation) to separate it from "environmental organization."
